name: tagztack-automation
description: TagZtack Automation — runs backend (Express + Playwright) and frontend (Vite) together

scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npx --prefix backend playwright install chromium
